scope: Labelled origin supplements for March calendar names whose reviewed history gives no origin.
method: thin151.mjs 03-01 03-31 listed reviewed March histories without origin wording; r153-data.mjs + build-r153.mjs (generated by makebuild.mjs from the round 151 helpers and the O-blocks of rounds 152–153) wrote public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements-r153.js, merged by public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements.js. Lithuanian comparison names in two-stem notes are checked against the LT calendar (lt2check.cjs). Skipped: names whose reviewed history already explains the word (Centis, Laimrota, Eridāna, Izīda, Normantas, Virve and similar), names without a secure base (Elerts, Balvis, Amalda, Imalda, Mārīte, Geda, Ginta, Kernius, Reda, Gina, Meda, Vilė, Eimutis, Arbutas) and recent EE names known only from registers. Rounds 153–155 share writer 1.9.130 and the audit research/namedays/round155-audit.json. Wording follows the 16 November rules (no sources, no Russian attribution).
